text: The man in charge of keeping McDonald's Monopoly fair... was the one rigging it.
Jerome Jacobson ran security at the company that handled the game pieces.
He knew which ones were winners.
And handed them to friends, family, and people he trusted.
They claimed the prizes. Again... and again.
In all, more than twenty million dollars.
Their plan? Ask McDonald's to keep the game running.
Dozens of people pleaded guilty or were convicted.
Jacobson got about three years in prison.
The one person who could see the whole game... was the one playing it.
